Detail: General Fund revenue from Exhibit G (zero-actual lines included). General Fund expenditure: Exhibit N object detail (p19-25; the v7 re-trim added report pp37-42, so it is now complete through its Transfers section and Total Cash Disbursements 3,780,888.76 on p25) replaces every nonzero program line of Exhibit G, so nothing is double counted; only Exhibit G's zero-actual lines (2172, 2620, 2712), the 8000 Transfers line and the Depreciation transfer contra/other-financing pair stay under Exhibit G, whose total (p11) counts the Exhibit N lines via includes_schedules.
